notes.title: Update-Lead
notes.content:
More light!
More music!
Each level is modified and improved!
New puzzles!

notes.title: Update - Sodium
notes.content:
The animation of coins with Pu (Plutonium) has changed.
Fixed bug in the appearance of the image.

notes.title: Update - Lithium
notes.content: We fixed bugs and improved physics in the game!

notes.title: Update - Hydrogen.
notes.content:
[list]
[*] There are 11 achievements, to get all the achievements you have to go through all levels from 20 to zero.
[*] Added gamepad support.
[*] Steam Overlay works when you press Shift + Tab.
[/list]
